title: Agent context during a session
scope: Research evidence read from source on 2026-10-12; each record states what it checked. Revalidate before relying on it as live behavior.

records.title: Pre/post-tool and other recurring hooks
records.scope: machine, project or lane according to guard authority
records.moment: Relevant tool, prompt, lifecycle or message-delivery event
records.current: Ordered tool chains enforce relevant policies, produce concrete refusals/repairs and deliver messages/launch context/advisories. Registration can recover on any observed nonterminal hook, separately from orientation. Composer caps delivery+hints+fleet report and may omit hints.
records.planned: P2 expands user hooks and dedup; P3 confines project/lane guards to their scope.
proposed_content: Only action-relevant guard/refusal guidance, changed identity/readiness, required message/launch delivery, and recovery when that action needs more context.
Do not repeat the manual, onboarding pitch or full project orientation on every tool.
Machine hooks run machine rules outside projects; project and lane policies require their respective context.
If optional guidance is dropped to fit the channel, keep a reachable full-read path and do not claim it arrived.

records.title: On-demand packets, command help and capability facts
records.scope: installed release; explicit project/item when querying live state
records.moment: Before using an unfamiliar command/schema/capability or when a deeper pointer is followed
records.current: main_agent startup names topic packet reads and operation --help. Packets give generated schema/recipe knowledge; actual item/project/claim/run state comes from registered live reads. Startup currently names a source-tree harness-manifest path that external projects do not have.
records.planned: Previously accepted installed help/manifest/context access repair.
proposed_content: Use command --help for invocation and refusal recovery, topic packets for current release schemas/recipes, and registered reads for live state.
Project pointers resolve to .yoke/docs and installed manifest copies supplied by the accepted repair; global pointers use real machine-reachable help or public docs.
Capability declarations identify supported behavior; observed readiness and QA receipts remain separate evidence.

records.title: Compaction and resume recovery
records.scope: existing session and current assignment, not a new project selection
records.moment: Context compaction, transcript resume, resumed ended session, restaffed worker or lost subscription
records.current: AGENTS requires reloading the current-phase skill after compaction. Skills have task/phase reentry and checkpoint rules. The lifecycle resume block reports claim reactivation; it is not a full context reload. Orientation markers are keyed to session ID and do not by themselves imply re-delivery after compaction. PreCompact routes to a dispatcher that currently handles SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and terminal events, without a specific compaction content branch.
records.planned: D should verify supported startup/resume/compact paths; P4 does not itself define a universal resume reset.
proposed_content: Rehydrate the current skill/phase, applicable operation home, scoped workflow instructions, live item stage/claim/lane and latest checkpoint before continuing.
Use durable item/strategy state and exact evidence pointers; do not replay completed transitions or restart onboarding merely because context was shortened.
Keep native transcript resume, ended-session reactivation and model-context compaction as distinct cases.
Add a short common recovery pointer to stable instructions; any automatic reinjection must be per supported harness/event and measured, not assumed.

records.title: Skills, phase homes and subagent mandates
records.moment: Skill invocation, next phase, dispatch or task-chain advance
records.current: Root skill routes to selected SKILL.md and reads phases when reached. Canonical runtime/agents bodies generate per-harness adapters. Conduct cold prompts include exact task/project/lane, live read routes, dependency interfaces, project docs, test commands and evidence.
records.planned: Full Yoke skill tree remains per-project; only yoke-global becomes user-level. Previously accepted role/reference navigation repairs remain distinct from docs movement.
proposed_content: Keep operational steps in the skill/phase that owns them and specialized mandates in role bodies/references.
Dispatch must carry exact assignment and authority/context read paths; never assume parent conversation or startup context reaches a child.
Route unfamiliar feature knowledge through help/packet/topic homes, then project-owned knowledge for this assignment.

records.title: Scoped workflow execution instructions
records.scope: configured workflow/project, including explicitly all-workflow/all-project operator scope
records.moment: Before creation, on item reads or stage entry according to saved delivery settings
records.current: InstructionDelivery records before_creation/on_every_read/when_entering_stage and stage buckets. Compact projections give descriptors plus a precise scoped full-read command.
records.planned: No new global instruction engine required by FIRST-USER/JOURNEYS.
proposed_content: Keep operator/project workflow policy in its configured live owner; resolve it at its declared delivery point.
Ship genuinely universal product procedure in product rules/skills, not by copying this installation’s private instruction rows or CURRENT-PLAN wholesale.
Do not turn every instruction into an always-loaded startup block. Never treat compact descriptors as the full mandatory prose.
